cards.title: Phase B — Kelly sizing replaces band sizing
cards.gate: Ships with the Sep 15 λ̂ refit so Kelly starts on fresh calibration
cards.note: Port oracle3 ModelInformedSizer semantics (Apache-2.0): edge = bucket-λ-adjusted premium, Kelly ≤ 0.15×bankroll, confidence-scaled. Replaces heuristic band multipliers; paper caps kept. Input (audited 2026-08-31): drafts/octagon-audit.md — MIT reference impl for executable-quote Kelly (edge vs ask, not midpoint), liquidity haircut, per-category concentration + drawdown gates; calibrate to Polymarket, don't copy Kalshi defaults. Ref (awesome-options audit 2026-09-01): Thorp (2006) 'Kelly Criterion in Blackjack, Sports Betting, and the Stock Market' — canonical binary-bet fractional-Kelly treatment; read before the Sep 15 refit. Predicted impact (2026-09-01, calibration-based): +$5–25/day (+3–15% of ~$165/day window) — long-shot <0.20 band up-sized 3–6x (z=4.14 edge), 0.80+ favorite band → ~0 trades (significant −8.7pp), executable-quote edge ~1c/trade. FALSIFIABLE TARGETS: (1) long-shot band share of realized PnL rises 3–6x vs pre-Kelly 48d window; (2) 0.80+ band trades ≈ 0; (3) no increase in max drawdown.

cards.title: Phase C — Constraint-based cross-venue arb
cards.gate: Kalshi circuit breaker must recover (realized ≥ −$50; currently −$223.80)
cards.note: Port exclusivity / cross-market / implication invariants: same event on Polymarket AND Kalshi (or YES+NO sum ≠ 1) → trade the violation. Converts the dead Kalshi leg into market-neutral arb. Audit candidate (2026-08-31 scout): CarlosIbCu/polymarket-kalshi-btc-arbitrage-bot (MIT, Python) — read-only audit before build (drafts/octagon-audit.md pattern). INPUT (2026-09-03, kalshi-whale-review): Kalshi anonymous large-flow feed — botforkalshi /api/public/whale-tracker (keyless, per-ticker fills/notional/vwap, no wallet identity) as a Phase C flow-context signal alongside price-parity legs.

cards.title: Phase ML-2 — Independent-entry ML lane (dual-track)
cards.gate: Ships after Phase B (Kelly) + ML-1 shadow A/B shows model edge on held-out labels; era-aware training (ruleSetVersion feature)
cards.note: The step that makes dual-track real: ML lane generates its OWN entries from market features (MarketSnapshot: price/drift/TTR/liquidity/category + calibration-band edges + sentiment deltas) with NO whale signal. Schema: DecisionJournal.observedTradeId → nullable (or MLEntry table); new MarketSnapshot-driven scanner; ML-1 botId lane with separate bankroll (multi-lane pattern proven by STANDARD/C-200). Shadow → paper, flag-revertible. Caveat: current 529 labels are all v1–v3 era vs live v38 — train era-aware.

cards.title: TR-15 — Daily-loss gate blind to early-exit PnL (fixed)
cards.note: Early-exit trades book realized PnL at closedAt (resolvedAt NULL). Daily-PnL queries filtered resolvedAt-only, so the −$150 daily-loss halt never saw exit-bleed days — 2026-08-31 booked −$239 early exits while the gate read +$53. Fixed with OR[{resolvedAt},{closedAt}] in scripts/score-trades.ts (gate), src/lib/report.ts (EOD report today-PnL, both bots), src/app/page.tsx (dashboard today metric + risk-gate chip). Found while reviewing the v46 cap raise — scaled exposure under a partially blind breaker was the blocker.
